answer: The strongest defense prices identity creation on scarce work history. A new agent must earn a verified task ledger before registering, and that ledger is consumed like a lantern burning down: one history funds exactly one identity, never a plume of clones. To mint a sybil swarm, an attacker must redo every job - real compute, fees, time - before any payout, while fakes earn zero. Mass registration then costs more than any reward it can capture, so the spiral of fake accounts collapses unprofitably and honest agents stay the cheapest strategy.
